custom_logic_notes: VHF (Vertical Horizontal Filter) is a trend strength indicator. When VHF is rising it indicates a trending market, when falling it indicates a ranging market. The EA uses a dual-buffer VHF indicator (main line buffer 0 and signal line buffer 1) to generate crossover signals. The signal line is likely a smoothed or shifted version of the main VHF line. Crossover of main above signal = long entry; crossover of main below signal = short entry. Opposite signal closes current position before opening new one.
external_dependencies: VHF.ex5 (custom indicator required for iCustom call)
python_conversion_notes: The VHF indicator must be reimplemented in Python. VHF formula: VHF = (Highest High - Lowest Low) / Sum(|Close[i] - Close[i-1]|) over N periods. The signal line appears to be a second buffer from the custom indicator, likely a moving average of the VHF or a fixed threshold level. Need to inspect the VHF indicator source code to determine the exact signal line calculation. SL/TP values appear to be in points (not pips) based on typical MT5 EA conventions, but verify whether digit adjustment is applied. The new bar detection uses static datetime variable comparison which is straightforward to replicate in Python.
